verification.subject: Your Carpooling UAL verification code
verification.intro: Your code to verify your email in Carpooling UAL is:
verification.ignore: If you did not sign up, ignore this email: nobody can use your address without this code.

passwordReset.subject: Your code to change your Carpooling UAL password
passwordReset.intro: Your code to change your password in Carpooling UAL is:
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password will not change without this code.

accountDeletion.subject: Your code to delete your Carpooling UAL account
accountDeletion.intro: Your code to confirm the deletion of your Carpooling UAL account is:
accountDeletion.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your account will not be deleted without this code.

trip.footer: You get this email because you ride with Carpooling UAL.

confirmed.subject: You have a seat on {{ driver }}'s ride
confirmed.title: {{ driver }} has confirmed your seat.
confirmed.pickup: You are picked up at {{ place }} at {{ time }}.
confirmed.details: See the details and your boarding code in the app: {{ url }}
confirmed.boardingCode: The boarding code appears in the app 10 minutes before departure.

finished.subject: Your ride with {{ driver }} is over
finished.title: Your ride with {{ driver }} is over.
finished.rate: Rate {{ driver }}: it helps the community. You have 7 days.

urgent.subject: Urgent incident {{ code }} on a ride in progress
urgent.title: Incident {{ code }} was reported during a ride in progress.
urgent.what: It is about {{ category }}, on the ride {{ route }}.
urgent.open: Open it in the admin panel to handle it:
urgent.footer: You receive this email because you manage Carpooling UAL.

reviewed.subject: We have dealt with your report {{ code }}
reviewed.title: We have dealt with your report {{ code }}.
reviewed.open: You can also see it in Help and support:
reviewed.footer: You receive this email because you reported an incident on Carpooling UAL.

request_received.title: Someone asked for a seat
request_received.body: Open it to accept or decline it.

passenger_joined.title: Someone joined your ride
passenger_joined.body: You accepted them automatically: see where you pick them up.

request_cancelled.title: A request was cancelled
request_cancelled.body: A seat on your ride is free again.

request_accepted.title: Your request was accepted
request_accepted.body: You have a seat: check the time and the pick-up point.

request_rejected.title: Your request wasn't accepted
request_rejected.body: You can look for another ride in the app.

trip_cancelled.title: The ride was cancelled
trip_cancelled.body: You can look for another ride in the app.

trip_started.title: Your driver is on the way
trip_started.body: Follow the car on the map.

trip_completed.title: Your ride is over
trip_completed.body: Rate your driver: it helps the community.

trip_auto_finished.title: We closed your ride
trip_auto_finished.body: An hour had passed since the arrival: rate your passengers.

trip_vehicle_changed.title: Your driver is using a different car
trip_vehicle_changed.body: Check the new car so you can spot it at pickup.

pending_requests_reminder.title: You have requests to answer
pending_requests_reminder.body: Answer them up to 10 min before departure or they will expire.

trip_expired.title: Your ride ended up with no passengers
trip_expired.body: We closed it: you can publish another one whenever you like.

trip_start_reminder.title: It's time for your ride
trip_start_reminder.body: Start it: otherwise it will be cancelled after 10 min.

incident_reported.title: New incident
incident_reported.body: Open it in the admin panel to handle it.

incident_reminder.title: Incident not taken yet
incident_reminder.body: It was reported 24 h ago and nobody has taken it.

incident_received.title: We have received your report
incident_received.body: We will review it as soon as possible.

incident_in_review.title: We are reviewing your report
incident_in_review.body: We may email you to help you.

incident_reviewed.title: We have dealt with your report
incident_reviewed.body: See our reply in Help and support.

chat_message.title: {{ name }} wrote to you
chat_message.body: Open the ride chat to read it.
